Every job here expects holds or parks, so the queue is not repinned and not in any plan; atlas-main18-smoke-1127 checks the stand-down line. Left on its old pin for the record. atlas-frozen-park-1126: Boundless Atlas docs/042, the frozen park of a held household Sim (G-202) and the RG-3 placement file (G-203), eight jobs on Sunset Valley (Baseline-SV, Keaton household of 2: the member that is not selected is parked). Order matters: save-sv (stopQueueOnFail) writes the scratch save Repro-AtlasPark-1126 that reload-sv (stopQueueOnFail) and nomod-sv load, so those two only run after a passing save; save-sv starts and off-sv (last) ends with the local step delete_scratch (the scratch save and the placement files). If the queue stops at save-sv or reload-sv, delete them by hand or rerun off-sv. Dry-run only on 2026-11-26; never run. Repinned 2026-11-27 to Atlas main 0.3.13 (boundless-atlas merge 726514d, game-copy/atlas-main8, docs/031 §15): placement calls are internal-call group 10; every Atlas repro first polls AtlasNative.Groups until freeze (and place where Placement=1) is set. Reading the result: roundtrip-sv and save-sv PASS = every extraAsi.logRequire line, no logForbid line, FZ-1 check PASS diffs 0 including the park items; control-sv must show diffs > 0; inserts-sv proves refused inserts end cleanly (C-042-6/7); selected-sv proves the selected-Sim exemption; reload-sv status=ok proves the placement file, save id and clock match (C-042-5), its check PASS proves the re-park after a cold load; nomod-sv proves the save needs nothing of ours (read-backs on both members); off-sv proves the switch. A RESULT REFUSED (no candidate, selected, wait-timeout) is not evidence; rerun after fixing the save.
